summary.text: Nickie Antonio (D-Lakewood) represents Ohio Senate District 23 and is the Senate Minority Leader. She was first elected to the Senate in 2018 and previously spent eight years in the Ohio House representing District 13.

paragraphs.text: Antonio worked as a Lakewood City Councilmember, Executive Director of an outpatient drug and alcohol treatment program for women, an adjunct professor, and a teacher for children with special needs.
The first in her family to graduate from college, she holds an M.P.A. and a B.S. Ed. from Cleveland State University.

In 2010, she became the first member of the LGBTQ+ community elected to the Ohio House of Representatives, and in 2018 she became the first woman elected to the Senate District 23 seat and the first LGBTQ+ member elected to the Ohio Senate.
After serving as Minority Whip and Assistant Minority Leader, she became Minority Leader, and she is Ranking Member on the Senate Transportation Committee.
She has introduced the Ohio Fairness Act in every General Assembly since 2011.
